'''The Dead Man's Breath''' is a [[Caemlyn]] tavern with a dark interior. Not much food is served, just strong drinks. [[Bernherd]] is the [[tavernkeeper]].

The tavern employed two toughs out front.{{ref/book|13|8}}

==Activity==
In this tavern [[Mat]] hears the rumor about the murder of [[Jowdry]] at [[The Farrier's Green]]. [[Chaser]] said Jowdry's "body was drained of blood, like a wineskin full of holes." Mat was startled, that murder could only mean one thing, the ''[[gholam]]'' was in Caemlyn.
